suite.title: Phynyx Growth Snapshot intake and recovery checklist
suite.description: Manual release checks for the first Growth Snapshot contact checkpoint, native AI Studio CRM capture, Workflow 001 routing, and Workflow 002a incomplete-assessment recovery.
suite.generatedFrom: AI Studio project 1789733833642057228 published 2026-09-23; Workflow 001 saved 2026-09-23
suite.scope: Published /growth-assessment first contact checkpoint, CRM contact mapping, Workflow 001, and the complete first-email pass through Workflow 002a as Ember staff in the Phynyx sub-account.
limitations: The custom production domain was not changed; the published AI Studio vibepreview.app domain was tested.
The 15-minute recovery email was delivered to the controlled AgentMail fixture; delivery to real customer mailboxes was not tested.
SMS and voice consent-positive delivery tests were not run; all executed fixtures left those permissions off.
Conflicting-identifier preservation (same phone with new email or vice versa) is a documented P1 gap, not a release-blocking claim.
Exact mobile visual parity and accessibility coverage are outside this intake-routing checklist.
